title: .agents/rubric.yaml (preset, generated) and .agents/custom/.agents/rubric.yaml (project override): the RV7b binary rubric (U6)
description: U6 decided 2026-10-15 (agentive:rubric@1 = spread 24, size 24, incident_history 24, change_type 14, recent_churn 14), revised 2026-10-30 (E2E-13): preset agentive:rubric@2 = spread 24 (>=2 production modules or a shared path among production files; tests and docs excluded), size 30 (>500 changed lines; tests counted; lock, generated and vendor files excluded), incident_history 30, change_type 14 (dependency only), recent_churn 14 (>=5 changes landed on the base branch within 90 days on a changed production file: first-parent history, a merged PR, a squash commit or a direct commit counts 1; revised 2026-10-31); binary scoring, score > 28 -> human. The override extends a framework preset, holds only what changes, is merged by item id, and switches an item off with enabled: false; extends naming a preset other than the one in .agents/rubric.yaml pins that preset (agentive:rubric@1 stays pinnable, extends alone is then valid). /agentive:update moves the preset and an override that extended the old preset together and reports it. No personal layer. A rubric change is tier 2 and a U2 confirmation target. An override that fails validation sends tier 1 to a human (tier 0 still auto-merges). `.agents/bin/agentive-lint rubric --effective` prints the effective rubric and its sha256.
